{{Quote|I knew it wasn't one of the tradeships or a courier on business from Hleua. The drive sounded different &mdash; it had this weird, deep grumble to it.|Baragwin sense lattice imprinted by a Republic soldier|<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}}</ref>}}
'''Hleua''' was an astronomical object<ref name="Author's Cut" /> located in the [[Hleua system/Legends|Hleua system]], a part of the [[Eucer sector/Legends|Eucer sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Tionese War]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> waged between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]],<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> the Republic-[[Colonist/Legends|settled]] celestial body [[Okator VIII]] was regularly visited by [[Courier/Legends|courier]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] on business errands from Hleua.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

Shortly before the war's end<ref name="Author's Cut" /> around [[23,900 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> a [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] military force [[Attack on Okator VIII|destroyed]] several Republic settlements on Okator VIII. A [[Unidentified Republic soldier (Falang Minor)|witness]] of the attack, a local [[Farmer/Legends|farm boy]]&ndash;turned&ndash;[[Republic soldier]], later imprinted an audio-visual account of the attack in a [[Baragwin sense lattice]]. In the record, the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] noted that the [[Engine/Legends|drives]] of the attackers' [[Tionjack]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]] emitted a unique sound that made them unmistakable for the ships that usually visited Okator VIII, such as the couriers from Hleua.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hleua was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned the astronomical object was cut before the book's release.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

The information regarding Hleua was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Hleua [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square Q-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
